description: Run the saved handler now and return its logs, return value and duration: on a stored event (the latest when event_id is omitted) or on a body you give. Counts as a run. Nothing is delivered, but whatever the code itself sends does happen.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

body.description: Run on this body instead of a stored event.

event_id.description: Run on this stored event. Omit for the app's latest event.

name: anyhook_code_test
title: Run an app's code on a stored event
